guidanceSections.title: Prepare · Tziah I
guidanceSections.body: Bring Strike, Electricity, Wind, Fire and Ice coverage, along with physical skills for 143F. Restore HP before the consecutive 125F/126F battles. Keep the rescues and later random Dark Zone achievement separate from boss clears.

guidanceSections.title: 125F / 126F · Consecutive guards
guidanceSections.body: Use Strike on Rampaging Sands and Electricity on Heartless Relic at 125F; Confusion can disrupt the Sands. At 126F, use Wind on Raging Turret. It blocks Slash; guard its charged Heat Wave after the buff sequence.

guidanceSections.title: 132F · Terminal Table
guidanceSections.body: No elemental weakness. Avoid Strike, which is blocked, and Light, which is drained. Use other damage, maintain attack-down effects and heal. Rage is an optional way to prevent its usual spell pattern.

guidanceSections.title: 136F · Jotun and Hands
guidanceSections.body: Use Ice on Jotun of Authority, Electricity on Purging Right Hand and Fire on Subservient Left Hand. Avoid group physical attacks: Jotun drains Slash, the right hand drains Strike and the left drains Pierce.

guidanceSections.title: 143F · Isolated Castle
guidanceSections.body: This gatekeeper blocks every attack element. Use physical skills, critical hits and Theurgy rather than elemental spells. Heal after HP-cost attacks; reach the 144F border only after clearing it.

guidanceSections.title: Prepare · Fortune and Strength
guidanceSections.body: Ken and Shinjiro are unavailable. Bring strong magic, party healing, Strike/Electricity coverage and charged Theurgies. Keep current HP above 300 wherever your maximum allows it: Fortune's damage roulette can deal a fixed 300 to everyone. If that is not possible, secure a survival effect or more HP before relying on this plan.

guidanceSections.title: Fight · Strength first
guidanceSections.body: Fortune cannot be targeted while Strength protects it. Use magic or Theurgy on Strength; it repels Strike and resists Slash/Pierce. Heal between attacks so the roulette cannot catch the protagonist at low HP.

guidanceSections.title: Fight · Fortune exposed
guidanceSections.body: In Reload the roulette runs automatically; there is no player timing trick. After Strength falls, use Strike or Electricity to down Fortune and All-Out Attack. Avoid Fire, Ice, Wind and Light because Fortune drains them.
